HEADING: Credits
BALANCE_EXPLANATION: Credit is money held on your FastComments account in [currency]. It is applied automatically to your future invoices, including subscription renewals and Flex usage, before your card is charged.
TOP_UP_INTRO: Choose an amount. Your saved payment method is charged now, in [currency].
TEXT_PAYMENT_INFO_NOTE: Payments are processed securely by Stripe. We never store your card details.
NO_CARD_TEXT: Top-ups are charged to the card saved on your account. Save a card on the billing page, then come back here.
ERROR_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: Your Stripe account bills in [customerCurrency], but your invoice currency is set to [currency]. Set the invoice currency back to [customerCurrency] in invoice settings, or contact support to switch currencies.
ERROR_NO_PAYMENT_METHOD: Save a card on the billing page before adding credit.
ERROR_CARD_DECLINED: Your card was declined. Check your card on the billing page, or try another card.
ERROR_PAYMENT_INCOMPLETE: Your bank did not approve the payment. Try again, or use a different card.
ERROR_RATE_LIMITED: Too many top-up attempts. Wait a while and try again.
ERROR_NOT_BILLING_ADMIN: Only the account owner or a billing admin can add credit.
ERROR_GENERIC: We hit a snag adding your credit. Try again in a moment.
